verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding agent, so debugging a live running web application is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents attaching to a running web app, browser or devtools integration, or live debugging. The closest items are a claim that Slate can perform integration tests manually and the ability to run shell commands with `!`. Those are adjacent capabilities, not live web-app debugging, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
